d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi bihar ko 'nitish setu' ki saugat dene aa rahe hain. is karyakram men bihar ki siyasat ka ek aur dilchasp pahlu samne aa sakta hai. charcha hai ki piem modi ke manch par neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav bhi najar aa sakte hain. sarkari vigyapan men tejasvi yadav ka bhi nam hai. halanki bataur vidhayak tejasvi ko aamantran mila hai. ispar aarjedi ne aitraj jataya hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
